annotations.text:
OPTION A · GeoCities '97 x Ragnarok Online
Same starfield build and layout. Small tweaks: the panels are now light RO-style windows (soft blue-grey border, white inner highlight, rounded corners, drop shadow) floating on the night sky; title in a pink-lavender-sky ramp instead of the full rainbow; sparkle-chain dividers instead of rainbow bars; pixel hearts in What's New; soft rounded buttons.
No persona copy - square brackets = fill in.

MINIMAL VERSION
Same starfield, title and window style, cut to what a visitor actually needs: a one-line intro, the four projects with one button each, four links, and counter + guestbook + e-mail on a single footer line.
Dropped: marquee, nav buttons, under-construction banner, About Me, What's New, the midi bar, webring, badges, bookmark line. About half the height.

ALT LAYOUT · left navigation column
Kept for reference; the centered layout was chosen.

OPTION B · Y2K personal site (c. 2001)
Silver header bar, dark-blue nav strip, Verdana 11px, left news column, bordered project table with versions and languages, validator badges.

OPTION C · ~will terminal (c. 1999)
Black, green Courier, ASCII banner, Apache-style 'Index of' directory listing, cat status.txt, blinking cursor.

OPTION D · 2002 pastel blog
Dotted pink tile, gradient banner, dotted borders, Tahoma 11px, 'currently' block, blinkies, lowercase everything.
